title: Pure Warrior
summary: An engine-free, generic Warrior strategy uniting high-level powerhouses with Equip Spell synergy. Immortal Phoenix Gearfried leads the charge with monster effect negation and non-destruction absorption, fueled by Infernoble Arms - Durendal, Heritage of the Chalice, and Magnum Shield. Sublimation Knight equips Squeaknight from Deck for a 1-card Link-2 starter, Giltia searches Gearfried while banishing threats, and EARTH extenders like Junk Forward and Comrade Swordsman of Landstar convert into Level 4 toolbox monsters via Promotion. The Extra Deck features a versatile toolbox spanning Naturia Beast, Crimson Blader, Claivesolish, Ferocious Flame Swordsman, and a 3000 ATK effect-immune Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Chaos.

main: Immortal Phoenix Gearfried

Lv 9 FIRE Warrior (3000 ATK): banishes 1 Equip Spell from field/GY to Special Summon itself; Quick Effect monster negate by sending an Equip to GY; and steals an opponent's monster at start of damage calculation to equip it as an Equip Spell!
Giltia the D. Knight - Soul Spear
Lv 5 LIGHT Warrior: Normal Summons without Tribute when you control no monsters, banishes an opponent's monster, and searches Immortal Phoenix Gearfried directly from Deck!
Hayate the Earth Star
Lv 5 EARTH Warrior: Special Summons itself from hand when your opponent controls a monster or you control no monsters; provides instant Lv 5 material for Volcasaurus or Synchro plays.
Tenma the Sky Star
Lv 5 LIGHT Warrior: Special Summons itself from hand when you control an EARTH monster (Hayate, Junk Forward, Landstar) and protects your Warriors by reducing opponent ATK.
Sublimation Knight
Lv 4 FIRE Warrior: equips Squeaknight directly from Deck on Normal/Special Summon to instantly summon a Tuner and form a 1-card Link-2 or Synchro!
Squeaknight
Lv 1 FIRE Warrior Tuner: Special Summons itself when equipped to a monster by Sublimation Knight, bridging directly into Ferocious Flame Swordsman or Naturia Beast.
Junk Forward
Lv 3 EARTH Warrior: free Special Summon from hand when you control no monsters; prime target for Promotion to recruit Level 4 EARTH Warriors.
Comrade Swordsman of Landstar
Lv 3 EARTH Warrior Tuner: boosts all Warriors on field by +400 ATK and bridges into Level 7/8 Synchros like Crimson Blader and Seven Swords Warrior.
Blue Mountain Butterspy
Lv 4 DARK Warrior: Special Summons itself from hand whenever any Warrior is Normal Summoned; enables instant Rank 4 Xyz or Link plays.
Valkyrian Knight
Lv 4 FIRE Warrior: forces opponent to attack only it, and banishes itself + a Warrior from GY to revive Immortal Phoenix Gearfried!
Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
Essential handtrap: negates card effects that add from Deck, Special Summon from Deck, or send to GY.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches any Level 4 or lower Warrior starter or extender directly from Deck.
Heritage of the Chalice
Searches any Equip Spell—or searches a 'Noble Knight' monster or Equip from Deck/GY; grabs Infernoble Arms - Durendal or Magnum Shield.
"Infernoble Arms - Durendal"
Equip Spell: destroys itself to search any Level 5 or lower FIRE Warrior (Sublimation Knight, Squeaknight, or Valkyrian Knight) and lands in GY to fuel Immortal Phoenix Gearfried.
Promotion
Normal Spell: sends a Level 3 EARTH Warrior (Junk Forward or Landstar) to GY to Special Summon any Level 4 EARTH Warrior from Deck and boost its stats.
Magnum Shield
Equip Spell: equips only to a Warrior monster to add original DEF to ATK (or ATK to DEF), turning Warriors into massive beaters while feeding Gearfried.
Living Fossil
Equip Spell: revives a Level 4 or lower monster from GY with negated effects; provides an Equip for Gearfried to banish before it leaves the field.
Reinforcement of the Army's Troops
Continuous Spell: whenever a Warrior monster declares an attack, Special Summons 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior directly from hand.
Called by the Grave
Quick-Play Spell: banishes an opposing handtrap or GY monster to negate its activated effects until the end of the next turn.
Forbidden Droplet
Quick-Play Spell: sends cards from hand or field to GY (including used Continuous Spells/Equips) to negate opposing monsters and halve their ATK without response.
Infinite Impermanence
High-impact handtrap: negates a face-up monster's effects from hand if controlling no cards, plus negates the spell/trap column when Set.
Armory Call
Normal Trap: searches and equips Magnum Shield or Living Fossil from Deck at Quick-Effect speed, triggering Seven Swords Warrior or boosting ATK mid-battle.
extra: Crimson Blader
Level 8 FIRE Warrior Synchro: locks your opponent out of Normal or Special Summoning Level 5+ monsters next turn after destroying a monster by battle.
Colossal Fighter
Level 8 DARK Warrior Synchro: gains +100 ATK per Warrior in either GY, and revives any Warrior—including itself—whenever destroyed by battle.
Draco Berserker of the Tenyi
Level 8 Synchro: Quick Effect banishes opposing monsters that activate effects, and gains ATK while attacking twice per Battle Phase.
Seven Swords Warrior
Level 7 EARTH Warrior Synchro: inflicts 800 burn damage whenever equipped with an Equip Card, and destroys 1 opponent monster when an Equip is sent to GY.
Naturia Beast
Level 5 EARTH Synchro: made with EARTH Warrior + EARTH Tuner (Landstar); mills 2 cards to negate and destroy Spell Card activations infinitely.
Heroic Champion - Claivesolish
Rank 4 LIGHT Warrior Xyz: detaches 2 materials during Battle Phase to double its ATK to 5000+ and force the opposing monster's ATK to add to its own for 1-hit OTKs.
Blade Armor Ninja
Rank 4 WIND Warrior Xyz: detaches 1 material to allow any Ninja or Warrior monster to make a second attack during each Battle Phase.
Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir
Rank 4 EARTH Xyz: defensive floodgate that forces all monsters on field into Defense Position and negates activated effects of Defense Position monsters.
Number 61: Volcasaurus
Rank 5 FIRE Dinosaur Xyz: made with Level 5 Warriors (Hayate, Tenma, Giltia); detaches 1 material to destroy 1 opponent face-up monster and burn for its original ATK.
Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder
Rank 12 LIGHT Machine Xyz: overlays onto any Xyz monster that battled to send all other cards on the field to the GY as a Quick Effect.
Ferocious Flame Swordsman
Link-2 FIRE Warrior: boosts all Warrior monsters on field by +500 ATK, and targets and revives a non-Link Warrior monster from GY when destroyed.
Aussa the Earth Charmer, Immovable
Link-2 EARTH Spellcaster: steals an EARTH monster from opponent's GY, and searches any EARTH monster with 1500 or less DEF when destroyed by battle or card effect.
Hiita the Fire Charmer, Ablaze
Link-2 FIRE Spellcaster: steals a FIRE monster (like Ash Blossom or Snake-Eye) from opponent's GY, and searches any FIRE monster with 1500 or less DEF when destroyed.
S:P Little Knight
Link-2 DARK Warrior: staple Link-2 removal and evasion boss; as a Warrior, benefits from Ferocious Flame Swordsman and Comrade Swordsman of Landstar ATK boosts.
Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Chaos
Link-3 EARTH Warrior boss: when made using a Level 7+ monster (Immortal Phoenix Gearfried, Crimson Blader, Colossal Fighter), becomes 3000 ATK, untargetable, and indestructible by card effects.
